scripts.build: rup-bundle && rup-bundle src/jobs/AppTicketJob.ts bin/jobs/AppTicketJob.js && rup-bundle src/jobs/AppTelemetryJob.ts bin/jobs/AppTelemetryJob.js && rup-bundle src/jobs/AppCacheInvalidationJob.ts bin/jobs/AppCacheInvalidationJob.js
scripts.docker:main: docker run --rm -e SERVICE_ROLE=main -e PORT=8100 -e HOST=0.0.0.0 -p 8100:8100 --name rupapp-app-main rupapp-app:local
scripts.docker:public: docker run --rm -e SERVICE_ROLE=public -e PORT=8101 -e HOST=0.0.0.0 -p 8101:8101 --name rupapp-app-public rupapp-app:local
